items.label: la gomme
items.scene: A little girl rubs out her pencil sketch with a pink ERASER as big as a brick that looks just like a block of bubble GUM ("GOM").

items.label: la lentille
items.scene: A mouse in a lab coat holds up a contact LENS shaped like a giant LENTIL ("lahn-TEEY"), a bowl of lentils on her stool.

items.label: la loupe
items.scene: A boy holds a MAGNIFYING GLASS with a curly LOOP ("LOOP") handle over a beetle, which looks giant through it.

items.label: la prescription
items.scene: In his brand-new PRESCRIPTION glasses ("prehs-kreep-SYOHN") a mole beside the big brass telescope sees the sky clearly for the first time.

items.label: l'aberration
items.scene: An ABERRATION ("ah-beh-rah-SYOHN"): the girl's bubble wand blows a perfectly SQUARE soap bubble, and she stares at it.

items.label: dentaire
items.scene: A mouse polishes a big DENTAL model of teeth ("dahn-TEHR") on a low table until every tooth shines.

items.label: l'iris
items.scene: A tabby cat sits behind a big brass lens that makes her golden IRIS ("ee-REES") huge, a purple iris flower tucked behind her ear.

items.label: le microscope
items.scene: A raccoon COP ("mee-krohs-KOP") in a blue cap peers into a brass MICROSCOPE at a single crumb.

items.label: le girofle
items.scene: A GIRAFFE ("zhee-ROFL") leans in through the open door to nibble a single CLOVE held out by the lady dentist (clove oil soothes toothache).

items.label: optique
items.scene: A toad peers through a brass OPTICAL lens machine ("op-TEEK"), his eyes enormous behind the lenses.
